name: Power-only 'greatest mana value among … you control' (Towering Gibbon, Daretti, Kraven, Dragon Man's battlefield half)
notes: All four parsed to no effect. Your Mindslaver (6), Daretti (5), Towering Gibbon (4), Dragon Man (4, an artifact creature), Kraven (3), Sol Ring (1), and Divination (3) in your graveyard; the opponent's Darksteel Colossus (11) counts for no one. Gibbon (creatures): 5. Daretti (artifacts): 6. Kraven (permanents, after an ability word): 6. Dragon Man (noncreature permanents and noncreature graveyard cards): Mindslaver's 6 beats Divination's 3. Toughness stays printed.

scryfallData.name: Towering Gibbon
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Reach
Towering Gibbon's power is equal to the greatest mana value among creatures you control.
scryfallData.flavor_text: "Don't worry, folks. We're perfectly safe here. That's a banana processing plant."

scryfallData.name: Daretti, Rocketeer Engineer
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Daretti's power is equal to the greatest mana value among artifacts you control.
Whenever Daretti enters or attacks, choose target artifact card in your graveyard. You may sacrifice an artifact. If you do, return the chosen card to the battlefield.

scryfallData.name: Kraven, Proud Predator
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Vigilance
Top of the Food Chain — Kraven's power is equal to the greatest mana value among permanents you control.
scryfallData.flavor_text: The hunter seeks only the greatest prey—only Spider-Man's death will quench Kraven's thirst for glory.

scryfallData.name: Dragon Man, Reformed Robot
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Flying
Dragon Man's power is equal to the greatest mana value among noncreature permanents you control and noncreature cards in your graveyard.
You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a card in addition to paying its other costs.

scryfallData.name: Mindslaver
scryfallData.oracle_text: {4}, {T}, Sacrifice Mindslaver: You control target player during that player's next turn. (You see all cards that player could see and make all decisions for them.)
scryfallData.flavor_text: It's a helm that leaves the head at its most vulnerable.

scryfallData.name: Sol Ring
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"Actually, 'warp core' is a misnomer. It is technically a generator, but it's not a warp field generator. For some reason, 'deuterium/anti-deuterium intermix reactor' never caught on. Funny, right?"
—Lieutenant junior grade Sam Rutherford

scryfallData.name: Darksteel Colossus
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Trample (This creature can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)
Indestructible (Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy this creature.)
If Darksteel Colossus would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, reveal Darksteel Colossus and shuffle it into its owner's library instead.
